criterion: which domain of everyday assistant use the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Information Query
categories.definition: Requests for general facts, definitions, trivia, or descriptions of entities.

categories.name: News and Current Events
categories.definition: Inquiries about recent happenings, headlines, stock market updates, or social media trends.

categories.name: Weather
categories.definition: Requests for current or future weather conditions, forecasts, or temperature.

categories.name: Time and Date
categories.definition: Questions about the current time, date, time zones, or specific dates.

categories.name: Calculations and Conversions
categories.definition: Requests for mathematical operations, unit conversions, or currency exchange rates.

categories.name: Media Playback
categories.definition: Commands to play, pause, resume, skip, or search for music, podcasts, audiobooks, or videos.

categories.name: Smart Home and Device Control
categories.definition: Commands to adjust settings or control smart devices like lights, vacuums, or smart plugs.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Actions related to sending, receiving, or managing emails, messages, social media posts, or phone calls.

categories.name: Calendar and Reminders
categories.definition: Setting, checking, modifying, or deleting alarms, reminders, or calendar events.

categories.name: Navigation and Travel
categories.definition: Requests for directions, travel information, booking transportation, or finding points of interest.

categories.name: Shopping and Lists
categories.definition: Creating, modifying, querying, or deleting shopping lists, to-do lists, or finding products or services.

categories.name: Games and Interactive Entertainment
categories.definition: Initiating or playing games, or engaging in interactive entertainment.

categories.name: App and System Management
categories.definition: Commands to open, close, or manage applications or general device settings.

categories.name: General Interaction
categories.definition: Utterances that are conversational, expressions of sentiment, or do not fit into a specific functional domain.
